claims.text: This Master Services Agreement between Harbor Analytics LLC and Juniper Freight Co. took effect on March 1, 2026.

receipt.quote:
MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of March 1, 2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between Harbor Analytics LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Provider"), and Juniper Freight Co., an Oregon corporation ("Customer").

claims.text: Harbor Analytics provides route-optimization analytics, a hosted reporting dashboard and quarterly planning workshops.

receipt.quote:
SERVICES
1.1 Scope. Provider will deliver route-optimization analytics, a hosted reporting dashboard and quarterly planning workshops as described in Statement of Work No. 1.

claims.text: The dashboard must be available at least 99.5% of each month, excluding announced maintenance.

receipt.quote: 1.2 Service Levels. Provider will keep the dashboard available at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance announced 48 hours in advance.

claims.text: The agreement runs for five years.

receipt.quote: 4.2 These obligations survive for three (3) years after this Agreement ends.

claims.text: After that, it renews automatically for one-year periods unless either party gives 90 days' notice.

receipt.quote: 2.2 Renewal. After the initial term, this Agreement renews automatically for successive one (1) year periods unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term.

claims.text: Juniper Freight pays a monthly service fee of $18,500.

receipt.quote:
FEES AND PAYMENT
3.1 Fees. Customer shall pay Provider a monthly service fee of $12,500.

claims.text: Invoices are payable within 30 days, and late amounts accrue interest at 1% per month.

receipt.quote: 3.3 Late Payment. Undisputed amounts not paid when due accrue interest at 1% per month.

claims.text: Either party may terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice.

receipt.quote:
TERMINATION
6.1 Termination for Cause. Either party may terminate this Agreement if the other party materially breaches it and does not cure the breach within thirty (30) days after written notice.

claims.text: Each party's liability is capped at the fees paid in the twelve months before the claim.

receipt.quote:
LIABILITY
7.1 Cap. Except for breaches of Section 4, each party's total liability under this Agreement is limited to the fees paid by Customer in the twelve (12) months before the claim.

claims.text: The agreement is governed by Delaware law.

receipt.quote:
GENERAL
8.1 Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.
